title: Easy Returns & Replacement Policy
heroDesc: Your complete satisfaction is our highest priority. If your harvest fails our freshness standard or arrives damaged, we resolve it within 24 hours.

pillars.title: 7-Day Guarantee
pillars.text: Report any damage, leakage, or quality issue within 7 days of delivery for an instant replacement or refund.

pillars.title: 24-48 Hr Fast Refunds
pillars.text: Approved refunds are credited directly to your UPI ID, original debit/credit card, or bank account within 24 to 48 business hours.

pillars.title: Hassle-Free Process
pillars.text: No physical parcel return is required for food safety in most cases. Simply share a photo on WhatsApp or email!

steps.title: Take a Quick Photo
steps.desc: Snap a clear photo or short video of the damaged tin, seal, or outer carton packaging along with your invoice or shipping label.

steps.title: Message Our Support
steps.desc: Send your Order ID and photos to our WhatsApp concierge at +91 99948 47167 or email support@intersting.duckdns.org.

steps.title: Instant Resolution
steps.desc: Our concierge verifies your request within 2 hours. We either dispatch a fresh replacement batch immediately or process a 100% refund.

eligible: Package arrived damaged, crushed, or tampered during transit
Inner aroma-lock seal or vacuum tin was compromised upon arrival
Incorrect item or weight variant delivered vs what was ordered
Any unexpected off-flavor or moisture defect reported within 7 days
nonEligible: Return requests submitted after the 7-day delivery window has expired
Items damaged due to improper customer storage (e.g. kept open in humid air)
Partially consumed items returned purely due to personal taste preference
Products purchased during special clearance flash sales marked final sale

support.hours: Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST

sections.summary: 7-Day replacement or full refund window for broken, damaged, or unsealed harvest packages.
sections.content: Interesting provides a 7-day hassle-free replacement or full refund guarantee if any product arrives damaged, unsealed, or fails our freshness standard. Report any issue within 7 days of delivery for instant resolution.

sections.summary: 24 to 48 business hours refund turnaround to UPI, Card, or Bank.
sections.content: Approved refunds are credited directly to your UPI ID (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), original debit/credit card, or bank account within 24 to 48 business hours. Zero hidden deduction fees.

sections.summary: Free reverse pickup across 19,000+ PIN codes; no physical return needed for food safety in most cases.
sections.content: We arrange a 100% free doorstep reverse pickup from your home across 19,000+ PIN codes in India. In many food safety scenarios, physical parcel return is not even required—simply sharing clear photos of the damaged container on WhatsApp or email is sufficient.

sections.summary: 3-step replacement process: take photos, WhatsApp order ID to support, receive replacement in 24 hours.
sections.content: To request a replacement: 1. Take clear photos of the damaged canister seal or outer box with invoice. 2. WhatsApp our support concierge at +91 99948 47167 or email support@intersting.duckdns.org with your Order ID. 3. Fresh replacement canister is dispatched within 24 hours.
